surface: the blind arena - 10 RAGBench subsets, 2,264 responses, the R8-H77 frozen gate
question: does any part of the assembled training mix touch the blind arena, in any channel, in any string form, at any granularity
contamination_wall: RAGBench source corpora and derivatives are FORBIDDEN as training data; this run verifies the wall, it does not test it
note: Numbers recorded, not adjudicated - the coordinator adjudicates.

arena.construction: R8-H77_unseen_arena.load_subsets() reproduced filter for filter: adherence_score non-null, response > 20 chars, >= 1 document, subsets with < 40 rows or one label dropped, sample(min(250, n), seed=0), first 8 documents per response

mix.assembly: R10-H108_lane.public_train() read UNTRUNCATED through R16-H142_G1_arm.untruncated_evidence() (one module instance, the way R18-H150_arm_run.make_build_mix does it) plus the five lanes of R20-H174_arm_run.LANES, each verified on rows, pairs and negative-family counts

R17-H143_evalset_assessment.build_mix_tr.what: that helper loads R16-H142_G1_arm and R10-H108_lane as two separate module instances, so its `arm.untruncated_evidence()` patches arm.H108.M59.CFG while the public_train() it calls reads a different M59.CFG object
R17-H143_evalset_assessment.build_mix_tr.measured: arm.M59 is arm.H108.M59 -> True; arm.M59 is <separately loaded H108>.M59 -> False; inside the context manager the two chunk_max_chars read 1000000000 and 1500. The mix it returns windows to 867,527 windows / mean 1.1406 against the banked 1,215,222 / 1.5977
R17-H143_evalset_assessment.build_mix_tr.consequence: that script's C2 evidence channel was measured against clean-mix text cut at 1,500 chars, so any collision living past that cut was outside its reach. This run does NOT use it - the mix here reproduces the banked R20-H174 window census exactly
R17-H143_evalset_assessment.build_mix_tr.scope: an observation about a different artifact; nothing is adjudicated here

C4_contamination_census.instrument: provenance_gate primitives, 8-gram, Jaccard >= 0.3, bidirectional, per-corpus attribution (the banked R14-H136 ruling-2 form)

C4_exposure.definition: a hit document is an arena document reading Jaccard >= 0.3 against some single mix chunk under the banked 8-gram instrument
C4_exposure.load_bearing_reading: NOT MEASURED HERE. Deciding whether the banked arena AUROC moves when these responses are dropped needs per-row arena scores for the banked checkpoints; producing them is a GPU read and all three cards carry live training draws. The exposure counts above are what bounds it.

documents.note: `max_single_chunk` is |ngrams(arena unit) INTERSECT ngrams(one mix chunk)| / |ngrams(arena unit)|; `whole_mix_union` pools every mix chunk, so a document re-chunked ACROSS several mix rows still registers

responses.note: `max_single_chunk` is |ngrams(arena unit) INTERSECT ngrams(one mix chunk)| / |ngrams(arena unit)|; `whole_mix_union` pools every mix chunk, so a document re-chunked ACROSS several mix rows still registers

response_sentences.note: `max_single_chunk` is |ngrams(arena unit) INTERSECT ngrams(one mix chunk)| / |ngrams(arena unit)|; `whole_mix_union` pools every mix chunk, so a document re-chunked ACROSS several mix rows still registers

spike_control.kind: synthetic spike - real mix chunks injected on the arena side

live_rechunk_control.kind: LIVE near-duplicate by construction - real mix chunks re-wrapped at a different window offset; no exact string form matches, the text is the corpus's own

live_cross_split_control.kind: LIVE near-duplicate by construction - VitaminC's own official test+validation evidence against the mix VitaminC train supplies 370,653 rows of; the official split is disjoint by unique_id/case_id but shares pages, claims and evidence text

negative_control.kind: NEGATIVE - arena documents with their tokens randomly permuted; vocabulary preserved, every 8-gram destroyed

summary.note: Numbers recorded, not adjudicated - the coordinator adjudicates.

controls.reading: every gate fired on known-bad input. The one miss is the Jaccard bar itself: 1 of 10 genuine re-chunked near-duplicates read 0.2796, under the 0.3 threshold, while its containment was 0.9954. The C4 count is a lower bound and the containment reading is the one that bounds exposure

arena_document_x_mix_claim.reading: the whole exact-match C2 signal on the arena is these units; their shape is what says whether a count of 1 is a leak or a degenerate string

ragbench_response_x_mix_claim_all_splits.reading: RAGBench short answers colliding with short training claims. The arena's own frozen filter keeps only responses longer than 20 characters, which is why the arena's response channel reads 0 while the full corpus does not

collision_characterisation.note: Numbers recorded, not adjudicated - the coordinator adjudicates.

containment_exposure.instrument: 8-gram CONTAINMENT - |ngrams(arena document) INTERSECT ngrams(mix)| / |ngrams(arena document)|, measured against the best single mix chunk and against the whole-mix n-gram pool
containment_exposure.why: Jaccard's union denominator hides a re-chunked fragment; this run's live re-chunk control read Jaccard 0.2796-0.8841 on text that is 0.9891-1.0000 contained, so the C4 count is a lower bound
containment_exposure.note: Numbers recorded, not adjudicated - the coordinator adjudicates.

verbatim_substring_proof.test: is the arena document present byte for byte INSIDE a training chunk - the form exact-equality matching structurally cannot see
verbatim_substring_proof.candidate_rule: arena documents at 8-gram containment >= 0.25 against a single mix chunk; a verbatim substring implies containment 1.0, so this candidate set is a strict superset

positive.kind: a real mix chunk's own interior 400-char slice

negative.kind: the same slice with one character changed
